scope: Quatro concepts individuais aquáticos; adultos propostos, não quatro linhas evolutivas. Grupo Quatro Marés definido pelo autor; nomes, funções e lore propostos.

members.name: Alvorraia
members.role: Abre caminho quando a água avança, elevando parceiros sobre obstáculos.
members.palette: turquesa, coral, marfim e índigo; olhos violeta
members.prompt: ADULT Alvorraia, incoming-tide guardian: an immense original manta-like living kite creature, NO legs, TWO broad swept pectoral sail fins rising in a powerful asymmetric lifting gesture, integrated short forward cephalic lobes made from TWO curled bamboo-and-paper guide vanes, not ears/horns. Small mature angular ray face on front body fold with narrow violet eyes, flat folded jaw and subtle gill-like paper slots, not bird beak/dragon head. Broad central diamond-bellied body made of ivory tensioned paper with coral and turquoise currents painted in big graphical forms; indigo lower sail plane. Bamboo leading spars grow from actual fin roots, coral-edged layered shoulder armor, matte copper sparse corner clamps, functional tide-knot at keel (a BRAIDED KNOT, NOT A GEM). Fins are several huge structured cut-paper vanes, not natural leathery skin or bird feathers. ONE long slim braided rear soul-rabiola, replacing ordinary sting tail, ends a coral/ivory fan flag, full root visible. Surface-powerful adult presence, compact body, long wide wings with clear left/right origins. Few connected splash-like PAPER edge shapes, no actual water effects hiding anatomy.

members.name: Coroabissal
members.role: Recebe a pressão da água e protege as passagens durante a cheia.
members.palette: azul-noite, cobalto, vinho e marfim; olhos verde-menta
members.prompt: ADULT Coroabissal, high-tide guardian: monumental compact WHALE-like original living kite beast, deep broad chest and blunt proud sperm-whale-like head, no trunk, no horns, no dragon features, mature narrow MINT eyes recessed under a stepped ivory brow. Distinct broad whale jaw with short toothlike PAPER folds only a few at corner. TWO powerful flipper fins, a compact body narrowing to TWO horizontal caudal sail lobes (not fish vertical tail), NO legs. Rich midnight/cobalt paper body, ivory throat, WINE red side planes. Grand dorsal crest is a spiraling vaulted paper-and-bamboo PRESSURE CHAMBER shaped like half a nautilus arch growing organically from back, not literal ship, robot or cannon. Mature substantial overlapping navy/copper armor at head crown and shoulder-flipper roots, rib-supported broad smooth inflatable paper flank volumes, few meaningful red knots at load points. A flat braided tide-knot seal under jaw, NO crystal. ONE separate complete soul-rabiola rooted at upper rear body before caudal fin, thin braided red/navy line with small folded shell terminal. Pose swimming forward three-quarter, both flippers and horizontal tail readable, imposing well-constructed mass, no tiny scale/fur texture.

members.name: Vortentáculo
members.role: Libera o fluxo retido e devolve às margens o que a corrente arrastou.
members.palette: ameixa, violeta profundo, ocre e marfim; olhos azul-gelo
members.prompt: ADULT Vortentaculo, ebb-tide guardian: original mature OCTOPUS living kite creature with EXACTLY EIGHT rooted flexible paper arms around a compact central underside, no human hands, legs or extra tentacles. Show FOUR broad foreground arms spreading in readable different S-curves and FOUR rear arms shorter or raised, all roots separate and traceable; each arm tapers to ONE tip. Tall angular plum/violet folded mantle like a pleated tidal funnel, small focused ice-blue cephalopod eyes on lower mantle, small tucked central beak underside mostly concealed, NOT human or bird face. OCHRE and ivory broad underside paper panels; large flat knot-discs along underside of arms act like suction anchors, few visible ones not hundreds tiny circles. Functional bamboo short segmented ribs at arm bases and important bends, matte ochre/copper armored cuffs on FOUR major arms, remaining four lighter. Upper mantle has broad stepped crown of THREE large layered directional sail plates, not wizard hat. One forward side siphon is a short CURVED FOLDED spout on body, not mechanical tube. ONE distinguishable thin braided soul-rabiola attached to BACK of mantle near top, with a purple/ivory crescent pennant; don't confuse with eight anatomical arms. Calm cunning mature command, spreading/draining gesture, no props, no crystal, no mottled realistic octopus skin.

members.name: Reciférreo
members.role: Mantém os abrigos entre recifes quando a água recua.
members.palette: verde-celadon, carvão, açafrão e marfim; olhos rosa-gelo
members.prompt: ADULT Reciferreo, low-tide guardian: massive LOW original CRUSTACEAN living kite bastion, not humanoid knight or turtle. EXACTLY SIX stout walking legs (THREE each side), plus TWO distinct giant front pincer arms, eight functional limbs total; six feet clearly spaced, no hidden extra foot. Wide flattened celadon/charcoal armored PAPER carapace in THREE descending offset terraces resembling exposed tidal shelves, broad folded membrane joins, ivory low belly; saffron warm accent edges. Head a SMALL mature angular crustacean mask set into front, TWO short eye-stalks with narrow icy PINK eyes, tucked jaw plates; no human face or gigantic cartoon eyes. LEFT claw is a broad shallow fan-shaped shielding shovel, RIGHT claw a compact deep anchoring hook, recognizable two-part pincers with hinge roots, not weapons held in hands. Substantial matte charcoal/copper forearm and leg-root armor; broad paper fin-like kelp vanes in dark celadon behind shoulder terraces, only FOUR well-designed large ones, not realistic plants growing everywhere. Strong bamboo perimeter ribs and saffron functional knots hold shell load, no strings binding creature like mummy. One braided tide-knot emblem on front keel, NOT crystal. ONE complete braided rear soul-rabiola ending a stepped tidal-notch paper flag. Powerful grounded defensive stance three-quarter, entire six legs/two claws readable. No natural rough crustacean texture, no rocks/scenery hiding limb roots.
